subject: Why students finish drafts once the outline exists
preview: The first sentence problem is usually an outline problem.
body: You're not behind because you're lazy. Most people stall because the first sentence feels impossible — and that usually means the structure isn't clear yet.
Tip: don't polish sentence one. Lock the outline (intro → 3–5 sections → conclusion), then generate section drafts in any order.
